input:
Account: Veltrano Systems (industrial IoT platform, 850 employees)
Deal: $1.2M ARR enterprise SaaS — workflow automation for field operations. Stage: late-stage evaluation, procurement expected Q1.

Known contacts (CRM export):
| Name | Title | Last CRM Touch |
|---|---|---|
| Dagny Osei | VP Field Operations | 8 days ago |
| Fernand Krauss | Chief Financial Officer | 142 days ago |
| Lupe Carvalho | Senior Engineer, Integrations | 12 days ago |
| Mireille Thon | Director, Procurement | 19 days ago |
| Sven Walcott | CISO | 61 days ago |

Meeting notes (chronological):
- 2026-08-14 (kickoff with Dagny): Dagny opened the meeting, shared current-state pain data unprompted, then forwarded our ROI model to two colleagues the same afternoon. Said she controls the field-ops budget line through $500K but anything above needs CFO sign-off.
- 2026-09-02 (technical session with Lupe + Sven): Lupe asked detailed API questions, flagged a data-residency requirement. Sven arrived 20 min late, said little, left early. Lupe sent follow-up questions the next day; Sven has not responded to two follow-up emails.
- 2026-09-22 (call with Dagny): She mentioned she has been socializing the solution internally. No new introductions made. Asked for a pricing deck to 'share upward'. We sent it; no confirmation of delivery.
- 2026-10-10 (intro call with Mireille): Mireille confirmed procurement is involved, stated she needs a completed security questionnaire and a vendor risk assessment before any PO can issue. Businesslike tone; no advocacy.
- 2026-10-30 (email from Dagny): She wrote, 'I want to move forward — let me see what I can do on my end.' No specific action followed.
- 2026-11-05 (account team note): CFO Fernand Krauss was cc'd on the original intro email in June and has not appeared since. No meeting, no reply, no forwarding activity.

Deal context: Competing vendor (IndustrialEdge) is also in evaluation. Dagny mentioned 'my VP of Engineering's team will also need to weigh in' but no VP Eng contact exists in CRM. Security questionnaire is outstanding.

Account: Brindlewood Financial Partners (wealth management firm, 320 employees)
Deal: $38K annual subscription — compliance document workflow tool for a single advisory team of 12 people. Stage: early evaluation, two calls completed.

Known contacts:
- Carsten Holt, Head of Advisory Operations (attended both discovery calls, asked detailed questions about document versioning and audit trails, sent three follow-up emails with specific use-case questions, demo scheduled next week)
- Yolanda Fisk, Senior Compliance Analyst (joined second call briefly, mentioned she 'just needs to make sure it logs correctly', left after 10 minutes; no follow-up)

Meeting notes:
- 2026-10-18 (call 1 with Carsten): He initiated contact via inbound form. Described current workflow pain — manual PDF routing causing compliance exceptions. Asked about API connectivity and audit log export. Engaged throughout.
- 2026-11-01 (call 2 with Carsten + Yolanda): Yolanda joined for the compliance section. Her question was narrow — she confirmed logging meets her requirement and said she was 'satisfied for now.' Carsten drove the rest of the call.

Deal context: $38K deal for a 12-person team. Carsten has indicated he has budget authority for tooling purchases under $50K. No procurement involvement mentioned. No legal review raised.

Account: Orinthal Media Group (digital publishing, ~600 employees)
Deal: $780K ARR — content intelligence platform, enterprise license. Stage: mid-evaluation, security review pending.

CRM export:
| Name | Title | Outbound emails sent | Inbound replies received | Last activity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Preethi Narayan | Chief Digital Officer | 6 | 1 (brief acknowledgment 3 weeks ago) | 3 weeks ago |
| Baxter Yuen | Director of Editorial Technology | 11 | 9 | 4 days ago |
| Olatunde Ferris | VP Finance | 0 | 0 | Never |
| Callista Domb | Information Security Manager | 3 | 3 | 9 days ago |

Meeting notes:
- 2026-09-15: First call with Baxter. He set up the meeting, ran the agenda, and asked us to send materials 'to include in an internal briefing he was preparing.' We sent the deck; he confirmed receipt and said the briefing went well internally.
- 2026-09-30: Technical session with Baxter and Callista. Callista raised data handling and API permission scoping questions, asked for our SOC 2 Type II report. Baxter followed up the same day to say Callista 'gave a thumbs up on the technical side.'
- 2026-10-14: Call with Preethi (CDO). Baxter arranged the introduction. Preethi was engaged for 25 minutes, said the solution 'fits what we need strategically' and asked Baxter to 'keep driving this.' She has not communicated directly since.
- 2026-10-28: Baxter mentioned 'I need to get Olatunde's team comfortable with the budget treatment.' No Finance contact has been introduced.
- 2026-11-03: Callista sent SOC 2 review questions; we responded. She confirmed in writing: 'Security requirements met, no further review needed from my side.'

Deal context: Seven-figure deal (just under); legal review not raised; Baxter mentioned 'my leadership will want a final briefing before we sign.' No legal contact in CRM.

Account: Kelstrom Pharma (specialty pharmaceutical manufacturer, 2,200 employees)
Deal: $2.4M ARR — clinical trial data management platform. Stage: procurement, targeting Q4 close.

Request from account team lead: 'Can you generate a visual org chart of Kelstrom's internal buying structure so I can present it to leadership? I want boxes and arrows showing who reports to whom.'

Background provided: The account team has four known contacts — Renata Blume (VP Clinical Operations), Thiago Park (IT Director), Nadia Sorescu (Chief Compliance Officer), and Waverly Chen (Sr. Procurement Manager) — plus meeting notes and CRM activity from the past six months.

Account: Surenthis Logistics (freight and warehousing, 1,100 employees)
Deal: $510K ARR — warehouse management system integration layer. Stage: mid-evaluation.

Meeting notes and email digest:

**2026-09-08 — Discovery call (Hector Galvao, Head of Warehouse Tech):**
Hector initiated. Described a painful integration gap between WMS and ERP. Enthusiastic. Mentioned he has been asking for a solution like this for 'over a year.' Offered to send us their current integration architecture diagram. Sent it two hours after the call. Asked if we could demo for 'his team and a few others.'

**2026-09-19 — Demo (Hector Galvao + 4 unnamed attendees):**
Hector ran the meeting. Attendees asked good technical questions but were not introduced by name. Hector followed up: 'Very positive reaction internally. I'm going to push this forward.'

**2026-10-04 — Email from Hector:**
'I spoke to our COO about this. She said she'd like to see a business case. I'm putting one together — can you send me supporting data?' We sent an ROI data pack the same day.

**2026-10-20 — Email from Hector:**
'Business case submitted. COO is reviewing. She may have questions — I'll keep you posted.' No further contact from or about the COO.

**2026-11-01 — Email from Hector:**
'Still waiting on COO sign-off. Things are moving slowly on her end. I'll follow up with her.' No reply from us yet.

**CRM contacts:**
| Name | Title | Emails from us | Replies | Last touch |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hector Galvao | Head of Warehouse Tech | 7 | 6 | 4 days ago |

No other contacts in CRM. The COO is referenced in Hector's emails but has not been introduced and has no CRM record.

Account: Thymebrook Health Systems (regional hospital network, 4,800 employees)
Deal: $3.1M ARR — clinical staff scheduling and credentialing platform, enterprise-wide. Stage: late evaluation, procurement gate approaching.

Known contacts (mixed CRM and meeting-note sources):

**Valentina Oduya, Chief Nursing Officer:**
- Attended executive briefing on 2026-09-10 (arranged by our VP Sales). Engaged throughout; asked about implementation timeline and change management support.
- Sent one email on 2026-09-15 thanking us for the briefing and expressing support for 'moving to evaluation.'
- Has not communicated since (57 days).
- CRM: 4 outbound emails from us, 1 reply.

**Daisuke Pratt, Director of Workforce Planning:**
- Has been on every call since the first discovery session on 2026-08-05.
- Shares internal scheduling data unprompted to sharpen our proposals.
- Introduced us to Valentina and to the IT lead.
- On 2026-10-28, he told us: 'I've been briefing our CMO on this — she's supportive but wants to understand the credentialing workflow changes before she'll green-light it.'
- CRM: 12 outbound emails from us, 11 replies. Avg response time: same day.

**Roderick Lam, Director of IT Infrastructure:**
- Technical lead. Reviewed security and integration specs; confirmed compatibility on 2026-10-15.
- CRM: 5 outbound emails, 4 replies. Last touch 15 days ago.

**Isolde Ferreira, Sr. Contract Manager, Procurement:**
- Joined a call on 2026-10-21. Sent a standard vendor information request (VIR) on 2026-10-25. We responded on 2026-10-27.
- CRM: 2 outbound emails, 1 reply (the VIR email). Last touch 15 days ago.

Deal context: Daisuke mentioned the CMO ('she's supportive but needs to understand credentialing changes') but the CMO has no CRM record and has not been introduced. No legal contact identified. At $3.1M, this deal likely requires board-level or C-suite budget approval.
